notes: Classic Era community-standard builds. Swords and daggers Combat are the raid specs; Assassination-heavy builds only become competitive with Naxxramas gear. Allocations validated against the Classic tree data.

builds.name: Combat Swords (raid DPS)
builds.summary: The default Classic raid rogue: Sinister Strike + Slice and Dice with Sword Specialization extra attacks, Blade Flurry and Adrenaline Rush. Weapon Expertise takes you to 305 sword skill against level-63 bosses, which is why Combat is mandatory. Assassination adds Malice, Ruthlessness, Relentless Strikes and Improved Slice and Dice for the finisher cycle.

core.why: +5 sword/dagger/fist skill: removes most glancing-blow penalty and adds hit/crit against level 63 bosses. Non-negotiable.
5% chance per hit for an extra attack — scales with every white and yellow hit.
+5% hit; rogues need a lot of hit for the off-hand.
+20% haste and a cleave for 15s — used every cooldown.
+45% duration; lets you keep SnD up with 1-2 point finishers.

flex.why: Filler to reach tier 2 of Combat; Improved Gouge is better if you bandage in dungeons.
Filler to reach 15 points for Dual Wield Specialization.
+2% damage to Humanoids/Giants/Beasts/Dragonkin covers most raid bosses.

notes: Rotation: Sinister Strike to 2-3 combo points -> Slice and Dice, then Sinister Strike to 5 -> Eviscerate (or Rupture on non-armored targets late).
One rogue per raid maintains Expose Armor only if there is no Improved Sunder Armor warrior; otherwise Sunder is better.

builds.name: Combat Daggers (raid DPS)
builds.summary: Same Combat backbone (Precision, Dual Wield Specialization, Blade Flurry, Weapon Expertise, Adrenaline Rush) but Backstab replaces Sinister Strike, so Improved Backstab, Dagger Specialization and Opportunity are taken instead of Sword Specialization and Aggression. Requires standing behind the target; used when your best weapons are daggers.

core.why: +30% Backstab crit chance — the whole build revolves around Backstab crits.

flex.why: Tier-1 Combat filler; nothing there helps a Backstab rogue.
Aggression only affects Eviscerate for this build, so it is a filler at 2/3.

notes: Backstab requires being behind the target; on bosses that turn or cleave, the swords build is safer.
Slower main-hand dagger (1.8) is best for Backstab; the off-hand should be fast for poison procs.

builds.name: Seal Fate Daggers (PvP)
builds.summary: The burst PvP rogue: Cold Blood + Improved Kidney Shot + Seal Fate from Assassination, Improved Backstab from Combat, and Master of Deception/Opportunity from Subtlety for the Ambush opener. Combo points come fast (Seal Fate) so Kidney Shot -> Cold Blood Eviscerate is always available.

core.why: Extra combo point on crits — with Improved Backstab you build 5 points in two or three globals.
Guaranteed crit on the next Eviscerate/Ambush.
+30% Backstab crit chance feeds Seal Fate.

notes: Opener: Cheap Shot -> Backstab x2 -> Kidney Shot -> Cold Blood Eviscerate; Ambush opener against cloth.
Preparation is not reachable in this build; the Hemo/Prep build below trades burst for cooldown resets.

builds.name: Cold Blood / Hemorrhage / Preparation (PvP)
builds.summary: The control-and-reset PvP rogue: Preparation doubles Vanish/Sprint/Evasion/Cold Blood, Hemorrhage is a cheap builder that works with any weapon, and Improved Ambush + Initiative give a devastating stealth opener. Less sustained damage than Seal Fate, far more outplay potential.

core.why: Resets Vanish, Sprint, Evasion, Cold Blood and Blind.
Cheap 35-energy builder, adds a physical damage debuff; works with a slow sword or mace.
Extra combo point on the opener.
Armor penetration and Rupture damage; prerequisite for Hemorrhage.

flex.why: Three points into Combat for Gouge duration.
One filler point needed to reach Cold Blood.

notes: Usually played with a dagger main hand for Ambush, swapping to a slow weapon for Hemorrhage spam is optional.

builds.name: Leveling — Combat Swords
builds.summary: Combat first for survivability and simple Sinister Strike gameplay (no positioning), Adrenaline Rush at 41, then Assassination. Ends in the exact 19/32/0 raid build so no respec is needed at 60.

core.why: Hit is the biggest early damage stat.

flex.why: Match the weapons you find while leveling; Sword Spec matches the raid end-state.

notes: Riposte (needs Deflection 5) is a popular leveling alternative to Lightning Reflexes + Endurance; it costs a respec at 60.
